concept: 后对象——走到异色格制胜
question_cn: 后对单象，有后一方的王走到与对方象颜色不同的格子上，有什么特别的意义？
question_en: Queen vs. lone bishop — what is special about the king stepping onto a square opposite in color to the enemy bishop?

options.text_cn: 没有意义，王的格子颜色对后没有影响
options.text_en: No meaning — the king's square color doesn't affect the queen

options.text_cn: 象无法攻击异色格，王站在异色格上绝对安全，与后配合逼近将杀
options.text_en: The bishop can't attack opposite-color squares, so the king is completely safe there and the queen can close in freely

options.text_cn: 王在异色格上反而被困住，不能自由移动
options.text_en: The king gets stuck on an opposite-color square and can't move freely

options.text_cn: 象会立刻换方向保护同色格，让后无从下手
options.text_en: The bishop immediately switches direction to protect its color squares

explanation_cn: 后对象的制胜元思维：象只能控制一种颜色的格子。王主动走到象的异色格，象就完全威胁不到王，后可以放心逼近。王站在异色格 + 后配合压缩 = 必胜。
explanation_en: Winning meta-concept: the bishop controls only one color. Step the king onto the opposite-color squares — the bishop is completely harmless there. King on opposite-color square + queen closing in = winning.
